comparison: same episode and initial pose; each model uses its own terminal RGB, prior action and actual recurrent state; visual inputs differ
limits: local gradient sensitivity, not intrinsic attention or a causal comparison under identical inputs
method: End-action log-probability Grad-CAM at each model's own successful final decision view
normalization: each positive map divided by its own positive maximum for spatial visualization; brightness is not compared across models; zero maps remain zero
